name: Skyfoal · Gremlet #26
description:
A pegasus foal still learning to fly. Mostly it does very tall hops.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Skyfoal in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
